text_block_list.text:
It's lunchtime, and the cafeteria is as
boisterous
as always.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Don't be stubborn, Hayahide! Have my
lunch! You
need it!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I can't! That'll simply compound
the
problem!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide's on a hunger strike, and I'm
worried
about her!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm not on a hunger strike! I simply
consumed a
large number of calories
earlier to optimize my
brain function in
class.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, I completed my
calculations far
sooner than expected,
and now my body is
storing an excess of
calories!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it! Well, if you want to get rid
of the
extra calories, then just do some
extra exercise!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But that might result in overtraining. I
can't afford
to deviate from my carefully
balanced training
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's my fault that I made a miscalculation.
It
wouldn't be fair to burden you with
more work
because of my own mistake!
choice_data_list_en: I'll make the adjustments, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You mean you don't want to ask your
trainer for
help? Why not? That's exactly
what trainers are
for!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well, when you put it that way... I suppose that is a trainer's job...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, as always. I don't know what
I'd do
without you.
choice_data_list_en: All right, time to get to work!
All right, I'm gonna work hard!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm here for you too! We're friends, after
all! Now
have my lunch so you can do
your best out there!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Were you listening to anything I just
said?

I make some adjustments to Biwa
Hayahide's
training schedule, and she's
able to account for
the extra calories she
consumed earlier.
